description: A PostHog hog function (CDP): a destination, transformation, site app or webhook source that runs Hog code on events, configured with inputs and event filters.

Hash.description: Hog expression used to compute the masking hash, e.g. {person.id}.

Ttl.description: Time-to-live in seconds (60 to 86400) during which repeat events with the same hash are masked.

Threshold.description: Optional number of matches before masking applies.

ApiKey.description: PostHog personal API key (phx_...) with the scopes this resource type needs. Pass it with a dynamic reference such as {{resolve:ssm-secure:/posthog/api-key}} when calling SetTypeConfiguration; never put it in plain text.

BaseUrl.description: PostHog API host. Leave unset for PostHog Cloud US (https://us.posthog.com); use https://eu.posthog.com for PostHog Cloud EU, or your instance URL when self-hosting.

ProjectId.description: ID of the PostHog project the function belongs to.

Type.description: Function type. Cannot be changed after creation.

Description.description: Human-readable description of what this function does.

Enabled.description: Whether the function is active and processing events.

TemplateId.description: ID of the template to create this function from, e.g. template-slack or template-webhook. PostHog copies the template's code, inputs schema and defaults. Can only be set on create.

Hog.description: Source code: Hog for most types, TypeScript for site_destination and site_app. When TemplateId is set and Hog is omitted, the template's code is used.

InputsSchema.description: Schema of the function's configurable inputs as a JSON array (use Fn::ToJsonString): [{"key", "type", "label"?, "required"?, "secret"?, "default"?, ...}]. When TemplateId is set and this is omitted, the template's schema is used.

Inputs.description: Values of the non-secret inputs as a JSON object keyed by input key (use Fn::ToJsonString), e.g. {"url": {"value": "https://example.com/hook"}}. Wrap each value in {"value": ...}. Inputs that the schema marks secret go in SecretInputs instead.

SecretInputs.description: Values of the secret inputs (API tokens, passwords), as a JSON object in the same shape as Inputs (use Fn::ToJsonString with a dynamic reference, e.g. {"api_key": {"value": "{{resolve:secretsmanager:...}}"}}). Each key must be marked "secret": true in the inputs schema. Write-only: never returned by Read.

Filters.description: Event filters that control which events trigger the function, as a JSON object (use Fn::ToJsonString): {"events": [...], "actions": [...], "properties": [...], "filter_test_accounts": bool, "source": "events"}.

Mappings.description: Event-to-destination mappings as a JSON array (use Fn::ToJsonString): [{"name", "filters", "inputs", "inputs_schema"}]. Only for destination and site_destination types.

Masking.description: PII masking: suppress repeat events with the same hash within the TTL.

IconUrl.description: URL of the icon displayed in the PostHog UI.

ExecutionOrder.description: Execution priority for transformations. Lower values run first.

UpdatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last change.
